scope: native two-owner cleanup before code or database upgrade
verified: The actual native CLI worker runs under each account over key-authenticated SSH in a disposable network-isolated Linux container.
Both accounts permanently select preparation-abort before original service state can be restored.
A pending or completed code/database mutation, observed peer database upgrade or existing recovery direction refuses this path.
Each owner verifies every planned original file and directory, routing and native schedule without requiring a complete backup pair.
Restoration requires the other owner's verified receipt plus a fresh challenged SSH inspection of its current files and permanent abort direction.
Concurrent changes to either owner's files are preserved and prevent reopening; explicit resumption rechecks the actual native state.
The fixture's native crontab failure occurs after routing replacement, leaving a real partial hold and unresolved release intent.
A native scheduler install followed by failed acknowledgment leaves a pending cleanup intent; explicit resumption completes it without installing the schedule again.
The native installed master crontab and absent application crontab are preserved exactly.

Cleanup succeeds with the private database connection file removed and no database backup or baseline, while an independent full native fingerprint verifies rows, schema, views, triggers and counters remain unchanged.
Terminal preparation abort requires both restored-owner receipts; recorded outcomes remain independently inspectable.

protocol.fresh_peer_inspection: inspect-preparation-abort with the requesting owner's challenge
protocol.explicit_interrupted_phase_resumption: resume-preparation-abort with phase matching the durable pending intent

limits: Missing or damaged maintenance receipts cannot authorize replacement of changed routing or schedules.
A possible database or code upgrade still requires the existing verified backup-pair recovery path.
Live outside-host execution coordination, writer inventory, native backup/restore transport and full-candidate rehearsal remain outstanding.
Exact-commit CI must run this path together with all upgrade, activation and paired-recovery scenarios.
No live maintenance, public file change, migration, provider write or financial execution occurred.
